resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record names Mark Twain National Forest; the 1962 survey description names the Clark National Forest. The story uses the record's name and says the sources differ.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: one compiled page and an NGS datasheet with no condition report after the 1962 first observation. No build, repair or removal date in either source, and a web search found nothing about this tower. The brief coordinates (37.4661, -91.1128) match the NGS position (37 27 57.7 N, 091 06 46.9 W) to about 0.0005 degree. The 1962 description names the Clark National Forest where the record names Mark Twain National Forest; the story flags this. The story is short because the evidence is short.
